title: 摩根大通戴蒙：AI政治与数据中心选址，正面效应巨大但尾部风险真实
speaker: Jamie Dimon

segments.en: I want to get on to that, but you mentioned the politics of AI, what would your advice be to the Frontier Lab founders and to governments in terms of how to resolve the politics of AI and address those tail risks?
segments.zh: 我想接着问，你提到AI的政治，你对前沿实验室创始人和政府有什么建议，如何解决AI政治并应对尾部风险？

segments.en: Well, these are different issues, okay, data centers, you build them where they're watered, you know, and I have them, I have the new ones in America, Texas and Virginia, and you know, people don't want them there, you're not going to win, you get lost, but there are a lot of states would take it that have access to power.
segments.zh: 这些是不同的问题，数据中心要建在有水的地方，我在美国得州和弗吉尼亚有新项目，但人们不欢迎，你赢不了，不过很多有电力的州愿意接受。

segments.en: And of course, you know, any big company has to be a good community citizen, so I think a lot of these people are doing it, they're going to town, you know, they're being part of the community, they help the community to get the rights, they, you know, make commitments that won't raise consumer electricity costs, it's just things like that, and that'll be work through.
segments.zh: 任何大公司都必须做良好的社区公民，很多人正在这样做，融入社区，帮助社区获得权益，承诺不推高居民电费，这些会逐步解决。

segments.en: And AI has these huge positive effects, I mean, I do think it'll cure a lot of diseases, and it'll save accidents in the roads and it can cause the materials, it'll make life unbelievable for people, the downside is obviously what you read about with, you know, the agents and mythos and all these things that can cause trouble.
segments.zh: AI有巨大的正面效应，我认为它能治愈很多疾病，减少道路事故，制造材料，让生活难以置信，负面则是你读到的智能体和相关风险，可能带来麻烦。

segments.en: And that's a legitimate concern, it's a real thing, I'm not going to get hysterical over, is it existential or not, what we're doing is raising or, you know, rolling up our sleeves and going to work to fix it.
segments.zh: 这是合理的担忧，是真实存在的，我不会歇斯底里地争论是否关乎存亡，我们要做的是卷起袖子去解决它。
